speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: 城は 神の御使いによって〓〓されてしまった都ももうすぐ…
original_en:
The gods' emissaries ravaged the castle.
The town is soon to follow...

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: 王家の地下道が開放されているはずだ一般人は 早くソルデへ渡りなさい <PART> 神の怒りに〓れたこの国は時を置かず無くなるだろうから…
original_en:
The royal underground path should be open.
All citizens, evacuate to Solde at once! <PART>
---
This town has incurred the gods' wrath.
There is no time to spare.

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: 今更 ディパンへ来ても何もありませぬ居るのは 王の後を追った兵士ばかり… <PART> 王の『民だけは無事に』との命〓は聞きますが後を追うのは我らの自由にございます
original_en:
There is nothing for you here in Dipan now.
Our troops follow their king to the grave. <PART>
---
The king's orders were to save the people,
but each is free to die for his king.

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: 妙に… 静かになりましたな…

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: 中は…どうなっているんだ…くそっ！ この足が立てば…！
original_en:
What's going on inside?
Curses! If these legs could move...

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: マルベス王妃まで亡くなったとは…ディパンはもう…終わりだ…
original_en:
With Queen Malabeth gone as well,
the end has come for Dipan...

speaker: Dipan Soldier
original_jp: …なんで…なんでこんな事に…くそっ… 〓生っ…！
original_en:
...What did we do...to deserve this?
Damn them... Damn the gods!
